subject: Founders allowance — temporary packaging exception request
messages:
From: Elena Romero <elena@launchforge.org>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@launchforge.org
Date: 2027-01-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: LaunchForge cohort — request for founders allowance and packaging details

Hi Vivek and Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. LaunchForge is kicking off a new winter cohort (starts 2027-02-15) focused on pre-seed, pre-revenue founders and we wanted to explore a tailored onboarding package with Redwood to support their first production tests.

High-level ask: a one-time founders allowance to cover early experimentation (we're thinking $6k in credits per team), plus a temporary dev discount for 3–6 months while they're productizing. Our program will commit to a short case study and a co-hosted workshop if we can make the package work.

Constraints to note: many of our startups are pre-revenue, and our procurement team prefers a lightweight MOU rather than a full enterprise contract for cohort offers. We also need a simple path to provision accounts and basic audit evidence (SOC2 checklist). Can you confirm what exceptions you could provide to your standard accelerator rules (e.g., eligibility, minimum commit)?

Attachments: ProgramOverview.pdf (PDF), MVP_requirements.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow if useful.

Best,
Elena Romero
Partnerships Lead | LaunchForge Accelerator
elena@launchforge.org

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Romero <elena@launchforge.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort — request for founders allowance and packaging details

Elena — really appreciate the clear ask and the timing. High level: we can do a tailored path but we prefer to structure it as a temporary onboarding stipend + a short-term partner discount rather than an open-ended credit grant.

Proposal (initial):
- One-time onboarding stipend equivalent to $5,000 in hosted API credits per accepted team.
- 20% developer discount on usage for 6 months after onboarding stipend is used/expired.
- Fast-track provisioning (automated seat templates) and a short MOU (we can provide a two-page partner MOU).
- We will provide SOC2 attestation and a checklist for procurement.

Request from your side: a small public-facing case study and a co-hosted online workshop (30–45m). If you need the full $6k stack, we can consider bridging the remaining $1k for top-10 teams contingent on additional marketing commitments.

Marissa — can you draft a short MOA and confirm whether Legal needs anything unusual for pre-revenue eligibility? Monica — can you flag any billing/procurement blockers?

I’m available for a 30 min sync today at 3pm PT if that helps.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Romero <elena@launchforge.org>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort — request for founders allowance and packaging details

Hi Elena — looping in a very short MOA draft and a proposed mutual action plan.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 0: LaunchForge confirms cohort roster and procurement contact; Redwood issues onboarding stipend codes and provisioning templates.
- Weeks 1–6: Teams onboard + workshop (co-hosted) + initial integration support (standard playbook).
- Months 1–6: 20% dev discount applied; teams requested to opt-in to a single-page case study template after month 3.
- Exit: Post 6 months, standard public pricing applies unless parties agree to extend.

Pricing specifics we propose to include in the MOA: stipend = $5,000 credits per team (hosted API usage), dev discount = 20% off list for 6 months. If LaunchForge requires the $6k figure for marketing, we can do a $1,000 marketing uplift for a maximum of 10 teams (LF-2027-004), subject to a short marketing deliverable schedule.

Attached: MOA_draft.docx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (LF-2027-004)

Quoted for context:
> On Wed, Jan 20, 2027 at 9:12 AM Elena Romero <elena@launchforge.org> wrote:
> > High-level ask: a one-time founders allowance to cover early experimentation (we're thinking $6k in credits per team), plus a temporary dev discount for 3–6 months while they're productizing.

Monica — any procurement notes we should include before sending the MOA over for signature?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

From: Elena Romero <elena@launchforge.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@launchforge.org
Date: 2027-01-21T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort — request for founders allowance and packaging details

Thanks Vivek and Marissa — this reads well and I appreciate the flexibility. A few quick items before we proceed:

1) Eligibility exception: Our network includes several pre-revenue teams doing early infra experiments; can LaunchForge secure a short exception so those teams qualify even without revenue or traction thresholds? We prefer inclusivity for this cohort.
2) Procurement: procurement@launchforge.org will need the SOC2 checklist and an estimate of timing for billing accounts to appear so we can coordinate disbursement of stipends.
3) DocuSign: please send the MOA via DocuSign (we can sign a two-page MOU).

If you can confirm the eligibility carve-out and send the MOA + DocuSign link today, we can finalize the cohort roster tomorrow and push the announcement.

Thanks — excited to run this with Redwood.

Best,
Elena Romero
LaunchForge Accelerator
elena@launchforge.org

[Attachment: ProgramOverview.pdf; MVP_requirements.xlsx]
